notes.title: Game is available NOW !
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone !

I am RA studio game producer Ryan ,from a one-man studio. 

"Vtuber Simulator" was made in my spare time alone.
I really like the culture of Vtuber, so i made this.

Translating into a language other than Chinese is very hard, there may be problems, please leave a message for advice.

Hope everyone will like it.

notes.title: The first announcement of the game
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I’m  game producer Ryan,
and also the only team member.

I am gald that "Vtuber Simulator" will be launched soon!
This game was originally only intended for mobile phones. 
After considering various factors,
it was decided to have a PC version.

The reason, apart from "the design of the mobile phone is so simple
that no one sees the advertisement, so no money can be made",
It also seems that a lot of people crashed when playing on mobile phones,
which restricted most of my game performances and systems. 
I think putting it on the PC should reduce this kind of disaster.

The following explains the difference between the PC version
and the mobile version:

1. The resolution will be changed from vertical to horizontal, 
and the UI will be adjusted again.
2. The part of the steam game trailer is still the PV of the mobile phone, 
which will be adjusted to the PC version later.
3. The plot is adjusted, and some unnecessary dialogue is reduced.
4. Chinese, English, and Japanese trilingual game version,
everyone can push pits to Japanese and American friends! (PC version only)
5. Some interesting interactive modes will be added during the live broadcasting


RA Studio, Ryan
